name: slack
description: Send messages to Slack channels via Incoming Webhooks

slack.setup.title: Setup Guide
slack.setup.description:
1. Go to api.slack.com/apps, click "Create New App" > "From scratch", name it (for example Filer) and pick your workspace
2. Open "Incoming Webhooks" and switch it on
3. Click "Add New Webhook to Workspace", choose the channel Filer should post to, and click "Allow"
4. Copy the Webhook URL and paste it below
5. Optional: to give the app Filer's picture, open "Basic Information" > "Display Information" and upload the image from https://filer-ai.com/assets/bot-avatar.png

Messages always go to the channel chosen in step 3. To post to another channel, add another webhook there and paste its URL.
